title: SB650 (2023 Regular): Relating to felon in possession of a firearm.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2023R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/SB650/Introduced; sha256 be901061cd834740e7542ceda35bc38783435939b34d88f8d79218fbe3f9406f)
provenance.note: Introduced version; no votes on file. The rest of ORS 166.270 is reprinted without change that the digest identifies.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (ORS 166.270): (6) The Oregon Criminal Justice Commission shall classify the crime of felon in possession of a firearm as crime category 8 of the sentencing guidelines grid of the commission.
